faq.q: How much weight savings does Titanium Brake Lever Pivot Pin offer versus steel or aluminum?
faq.a: Titanium Brake Lever Pivot Pin fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides a 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130 chromoly steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at the same strength. Compared to 6061-T6 aluminum, titanium's 3× higher yield strength (830 vs 275 MPa) allows 50-60% thinner walls, resulting in a net weight comparable to aluminum with 4× better fatigue life — critical for brake lever pivot.
